usedFor: LiveChat holds your conversations, and each “Finished Chat” saves a lead in Sangam CRM.

bestTemplate.name: “Finished Chat” in LiveChat, then “Create or Update Lead” in Sangam CRM
bestTemplate.why: Each ended chat leaves a lead in Sangam CRM, created or updated rather than duplicated.

watchOut: “Create or Update Lead” in Sangam CRM matches by ID, email or phone, so a chat without one can't match.
